draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and direct, pointing out a discrepancy
notes: Very often placed directly after a verb to show an action was done wrongly: 写错 (xiěcuò, write wrongly), 走错 (zǒucuò, go the wrong way), 买错 (mǎicuò, buy the wrong thing).
Also used as a noun meaning 'mistake' or 'fault', as in 犯错 (fàncuò, make a mistake) or 是我的错 (shì wǒ de cuò, it's my fault).

examples.translation: Sorry, I dialed the wrong number.
